title: Commercial Natural Gas Supply Terms: Number of Sites and One Live Agreement per Site
content:
**Clause 1 — Number of sites.** A business may enroll any number of its commercial sites for Commercial Natural Gas Supply; there is no limit per customer.

**Clause 2 — One live agreement per site.** No other Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement on the same site may be in enrollment pending, active or drop pending status when a new gas enrollment is submitted.

**Clause 3 — Evidence.** Whether another agreement on the site is in one of those statuses is read from the company's commercial gas agreement records for that site, as they stand when the new enrollment is submitted. The site is identified by its premise on the agreement record.

## Clause 2 in table form

| Status of another commercial gas agreement on the same site when the new enrollment is submitted | Effect of Clause 2 on the new enrollment |
|---|---|
| Enrollment pending | Not permitted |
| Active | Not permitted |
| Drop pending | Not permitted |
| Closed, withdrawn or rejected | Clause 2 places no bar |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A restaurant group holds active Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas agreements on three of its kitchens and asks to enroll a fourth kitchen. Clause 1 sets no limit on the number of sites, and the agreements on the other three kitchens are on different sites, so Clause 2 is not engaged by them.
- A laundry's agreement on its only site is drop pending after a confirmed cancellation. A new gas enrollment for that same site, submitted while that agreement is still drop pending, is not permitted under Clause 2.
- A school's earlier agreement on a site was withdrawn before the utility confirmed it. Clause 2 places no bar on a new enrollment for that site.
